Subject: Security & Compliance discovery — post-call recap

Hi Ethan / Laura —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement timeline: 

Key items discussed:
- Primary use: inference for customer support summarization and embeddings for search (PII redaction in pipeline).
- Data types: customer support transcripts and some limited health-related notes for a subset of customers (HIPAA scope discussion needed).
- Residency: FinCo prefers US-only data residency; potential for EU subset later.
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 report (Type II), BAA for HIPAA, vendor security questionnaire, and ISO 27001 roadmap.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Share our latest SOC 2 artifacts (draft Type II) + high-level SOC scope — Rishi (attached) — EOD today.
2) Circulate vendor security questionnaire (FinCo) and assign to SE — Monica to start the questionnaire this week.
3) Technical follow-up on HIPAA & data residency with Security — Vivek to join for a short session; propose 45-min workshop next week.
4) Share ISO 27001 and FedRAMP roadmap (timeline & milestones) — internal Security/Product to provide a brief.

Attachments: SOC2-type2-draft-2025.pdf (redacted), redwood-security-worksheet.docx

If that looks right, I can share the Drive folder and Monica will start filling the vendor questionnaire. Proposed follow-up: Tue 24 Mar or Wed 25 Mar for the security workshop — what works for you?

Best,

Subject: Re: Security & Compliance discovery — post-call recap

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs from procurement and security so we can get the questionnaire routed: 

1) SOC 2: Is the attached SOC 2 a Type II report (covering controls over a period) or Type I? If Type II, what's the covered period? We need the auditor and date range for our records.
2) HIPAA: We'll need a BAA if Redwood will process PHI for any customers. Do you sign BAAs as standard? Any details on how you support BAA requirements (audit logging, access controls, data segmentation)?
3) Data residency & encryption: Confirm whether production inference and KV cache can be restricted to US regions and whether keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM).
4) Vendor questionnaire: I'll attach the FinCo security questionnaire (spreadsheet). We typically need this back within 10 business days for an RFP track. Can you confirm owners and an ETA?

Procurement timeline: we're aiming to evaluate vendors and have security completed by end of April to make a Q2 decision. If you can get the SOC details and the questionnaire started this week, that keeps you on track.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the SOC clarifications and Monica’s note on the questionnaire ETA.

—Ethan
Director, Procurement | FinCo
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@finco.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance discovery — SOC 2 + questionnaire ETA

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for the questions, happy to own the questionnaire. Quick answers inline and the plan: 

1) SOC 2: The attached PDF is a draft Type II engagement report covering controls Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025. Auditor: BrightAudits LLP. Final signed report expected after their review cycle; we can provide the current evidence bundle and interim management response now.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Yes, Redwood executes a standard BAA with customers that require it. We support the typical controls: role-based access, strict IAM, encryption at rest/in transit, detailed audit logging, and data deletion workflows. For PHI handling we recommend a scoped deployment and additional logging/retention configuration — Vivek can provide specifics.

3) Data residency & KMS: Production inference can be restricted to US regions (we have dedicated VPC options). We support customer-managed keys via standard KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and can work with HSM/KMS vendors as needed. KV cache can be disabled or configured to reside in regulated regions.

4) Vendor questionnaire: I’ve started populating the spreadsheet with high-level answers and flagged a few items that need security input (audit logs, key-management detail, BAA clause references). ETA: I can deliver a completed first pass by 2026-03-25 EOD.

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-FinCo.xlsx (first-pass answers)

Next step: Vivek, can you confirm encryption/key mgmt wording and whether we can provide a scoped SOC 2 evidence package (redacted) for FinCo? Also: Rishi, I propose we book the 45-min security workshop for Tue Mar 24 10:00-10:45 PT — Ethan/Laura, does that work?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security & Compliance discovery — technical notes and roadmap

Hi all —

Short technical clarifications from Security: 
- SOC 2 scope: We can provide an evidence bundle (control narratives, control tests, and select logs) that is redacted for customer-specific data. The draft Type II covers the calendar 2025 period and the auditor is BrightAudits LLP.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest. Customer-managed keys supported via AWS KMS/GCP KMS. HSM integration is available for Dedicated & Private deployments.
- Audit logging: We retain control-plane and data-plane audit logs per customer; customizable retention windows. We can provide sample log extracts for review.
- HIPAA: We will sign BAAs. For customers that bring PHI, we recommend a scoped deployment (Dedicated or Private) and enable extensive audit/event logging plus restricted admin access.
- ISO / FedRAMP roadmap: ISO 27001 is planned for mid-FY27 (target Q2 FY27 start); SOC scope expansion (to include additional infra & ops controls) is under review for Q4 2026. FedRAMP is being scoped for later engagement and will likely be a 12–18 month effort after scoping approval.

I can join the workshop on Tue Mar 24 10:00 PT. Proposed agenda (45 min): 1) SOC 2 scope & artifacts (10 min); 2) HIPAA / BAA specifics and recommended deployment options (15 min); 3) KMS / key mgmt and logging (10 min); 4) Next steps & timeline (10 min).

DocuSign link to accept non-disclosure / questionnaire routing: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/12345-finco-vsq

If that works, Monica will upload the completed questionnaire and I’ll provide the supporting security snippets for any flagged items.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
